purpose: Finite nextLoad format hints for the already-pinned typeless CommonJS .js files only; no executable scope or package mutation.
observedFailure: The first attempt refused pinned tldts/dist/cjs/index.js before all nine selected cases; the actual returned format was not journalled and is unknown.

sourceBasis.finding: The CJS default load returns the supplied context.format; typeless .js need not supply it before the full load chain completes.
Synchronous nextLoad merges supplied context properties; capture input before that merge for the journal.
The synchronous load contract accepts format context and says it is mandatory for default nextLoad without explicit module type.

rule: Only an exact listed dependency URL with matching bytes and reviewed nearest typeless package metadata receives format=commonjs when incoming context.format is null or undefined. Explicit commonjs remains unchanged; contradictory explicit formats are refused. Every returned non-builtin format must still be module, commonjs or json.
